text:
Which statement describes monochromatic light?
A
light that does not diffract
B
light that has a single frequency
C
light that spreads out when shone through a glass prism
D
light that travels at the same speed in all materials

options.label: B
options.text: light that has a single frequency

options.label: C
options.text: light that spreads out when shone through a glass prism

options.label: D
options.text: light that travels at the same speed in all materials
